chichester.snapshot: Chichester is a CityFibre town in the middle of a full fibre build, with more than one network digging across the city and a busy commercial cabling scene around its business parks. We serve both ordering routes here: build contractors and structured-cabling firms running fleets of engineers buy on trade accounts, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account. Fleet and single installer get branded workwear the same way.
chichester.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of West Sussex
s1loc: Chichester is a genuine full fibre city. CityFibre has built its own network past more than 12,000 premises across the city, while Openreach keeps pushing fibre straight to the premises through the West Sussex programme, so two networks have crews on the ground. Delivery partners run civils gangs, jointers and fibre engineers through Whyke, Summersdale, Parklands, Fishbourne and Tangmere alongside the rollout, while the major mobile networks keep upgrading on top. On any week you will find gangs working the city's footways, chambers and cabinets the year round.

Around the residential build sits a strong commercial scene. Chichester Business Park out at Tangmere and the Terminus Road industrial estate southwest of the centre host manufacturing, logistics and trade firms, while the University of Chichester campuses and the offices around the city centre add to the mix, and all of it needs structured cabling in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre plus CCTV. Local cabling and security installers wire these premises, schools and multi-site businesses across West Sussex, working alongside the broadband crews and giving Chichester a steady blend of network build and commercial fit-out work.
